text:
maria: FYI customer argo-inc hitting 429s + high latency on Dedicated pool in us-west-2 during morning ramp (06:30 PST). They say requests queue for ~60-120s before any tokens are returned.

kevin: Looking at infra traces — autoscaler started a scale-up but new pods stayed Pending for ~90s. Node group uses preemptible instances; I see multiple preemption events around the same time. Also a bunch of init containers doing heavy image pulls.

samir: Repro steps I ran: 1) Create load at 200r/s to the customer's route. 2) Observe HPA target go from 2 -> 8. 3) Autoscaler API returns scale intent but cloud provider shows "InsufficientInstanceCapacity" then 2 x spot preemptions. 4) Pods line up in Pending due to imagePullBackOff and then scheduling wait.

kevin: Logs snippet: ```kube-scheduler: fit predicate failed: Insufficient memory for pod default/worker-abc; autoscaler: ScaleUp: Requesting 3 nodes for pending pods; cloud: Failed to launch: InsufficientInstanceCapacity```

maria: So root causes look like (a) min_replicas floor is too low for this burst pattern, (b) using preemptible instances + large images = slow warmup, (c) imagePullBackOff amplifies the delay. Customer has strict bursty traffic window.

jess: Customer is P1 — they've opened a billing-impacting ticket. Immediate mitigation options: set a temporary override min_replicas=4 for their pool, enable a warm pool (keep 1-2 warm nodes), or move their dedicated node group to non-preemptible instances. Which should we do while we investigate?

samir: Quick patch I tested on staging: bumped min_replicas to 4 + enabled local image cache on nodes -> median scheduling latency dropped from 85s to 12s under same load.

kevin: Long-term: we should detect heavy init-container image pulls during scale and 1) prefer non-preemptible for customer SLA tiers, 2) surface warm-pool recommendations to console, 3) add autoscaler gating rule: if many pods Pending due to imagePullBackOff, spin up nodes from warm pool or apply fast-path kernel.

maria: Action plan for now: 1) apply override min_replicas=4 for argo-inc (temporary), 2) enable warm nodes in their nodegroup, 3) ask customer to reduce image size / use smaller runtime, 4) follow-up ticket to infra for non-preemptible option. I'll patch the config and monitor.

deploy-bot: applied override: dedicated/argo-usw2 -> min_replicas=4 (requested by maria).

maria: Monitoring update: after override and warm nodes, 429s stopped within 3 minutes and p95 latency back to baseline. I'll keep ticket open and schedule a runbook update for "bursty traffic warmup". Ticket: CUST-1234. :white_check_mark:
